title: Sid Meier's Civilization
description: Sid Meier's Civilization is a turn-based strategy 4X video game created by Sid Meierand Bruce Shelley for MicroProse in 1991. The game's objective is to "Build an empire to stand the test of time": it begins in 4000 BCand the players attempt to expand and develop their empires through the ages from the ancient era until modern and near-future times.
